messages:
nina: kicking off RC from main: rc-2026-03-23.c2 (sha=def5678). proposing promo window 2026-03-25 22:00-02:00 PT. asking for quick acks or holds.

raj: infra ack, will pre-warm KV and run minibatch calibration. I'll add a short eval job that runs the production prompt set against the candidate and baseline.

deploybot: deploybot: RC artifact uploaded rc-2026-03-23.c2 (sha=def5678). Commands: `/deploy canary rc-2026-03-23.c2 --percent 3 --duration 8m` then `/deploy promote rc-2026-03-23.c2 --to prod --pin def5678`

ops_kim: ops hold for 30m please. noticed a migration flag in the release notes that needs a knob. can you patch the flag default?

nina: good catch. setting `feature.migration_enabled=false` by default and pushing a config override.

paul_pm: release notes updated: https://git/release-notes/456. callouts: migration flag, rerank tweak, user-visible logging for debugging. We'll monitor #prod-user-tickets.

sheriff: oncall here. rollback triggers suggested: 1) 5xx spike >2% sustained for 5m, 2) end-to-end latency p95 jump >250ms sustained for 10m, 3) increased token-cost >15% vs baseline for 10m. I can execute rollback.

raj: added a temporary traffic tag so canary traffic comes from internal test cohort only. Also set batch size safe ceiling.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary at 2026-03-25T22:05:00Z. Pre-hooks: kv-warm, smoke-check, eval-run.

nina: smoke script: `scripts/smoke.sh --env prod --tag canary` — please run once canary starts.

ops_kim: releasing hold. config override applied and verified.

raj: canary started, rolling 3% now. smoke results: simple pass, 2 failures out of 200, investigation shows flaky external API, not RC regression.

sheriff: watching dashboards. no alarms yet.

deploybot: deploybot: canary moved to 25% after 10m.

raj: eval-run results in S3: s3://redwood-telemetry/canary/rc-2026-03-23.c2/eval.log. P95 latency diff +40ms, errors unchanged, token-cost +3%. Good to proceed.

paul_pm: product ok to promote. will coordinate support rota during window.

nina: final promote in 10m if metrics hold. Reminder rollback command: `scripts/rollback_rc.sh def5678` and ` /deploy promote previous --to prod` (if needed).

sheriff: confirmed. I have alert playbook ready and will call incident if triggers hit. postmortem owner: @paul_pm if we need rollback.

nina: promoting now. /deploy promote rc-2026-03-23.c2 --to prod --pin def5678

deploybot: deploybot: promotion started. Canary -> full rollout. Rolling through regions with staged ramps.

raj: monitoring infra metrics and KV warmth across regions. no capacity issues. fallback route `model-v1-quant` pinned as emergency.

sheriff: no immediate alarms. p95 within expected delta.

paul_pm: thanks team. I'll open a short status blurb for customers and update the changelog entry.

nina: closing thread; recorded promo in calendar and created a follow-up doc for post-deploy checks. :white_check_mark:
